title: Auditable Role Delegation & Scope Editor for RBAC v2
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Problem: RBAC v2 introduces scoped roles, temporary delegation, and richer permission expressions. We need a Console UX that lets admins and delegated owners safely create and assign roles, preview effective permissions, and surface an auditable change history without overwhelming users. Current role editor flows are flat and do not represent scope or delegation; member assignment is awkward for bulk and temporary adds.

Goal: Ship a role editor and member assignment flow that supports: scoped role creation (resource scoping), delegation with duration (temporary elevation), preview of effective permissions per member, clear audit metadata on changes (who, why, duration, source), and bulk-friendly member assignment with invite and SSO-mapping hints. The UI should make risky changes explicit and provide easy rollback / revert.

Scope (UI only): role creation/editing canvas, scoped resource picker, delegation panel (timebox + reason), member assignment modal (bulk CSV + SSO attribute hints), effective permissions preview, change diff and audit trail viewer embedded in role details, confirmation & blackout warnings for high-impact permissions. Backend integrations (audit events / SSO attribute mapping / temporary role tokens) are covered in ENG-4120 and PM-890 (dependency).
acceptance_criteria: A role editor UI that lets a user define a role name, description, permission set, and an optional resource scope (namespace, project, dataset)
Delegation flow: allow role owners to grant a role to a user or group for a configurable duration (start/end) with required rationale text; UI shows countdown and expiry warnings
Effective permissions preview: when assigning, show a per-member calculation of combined permissions (role + org/group inherited) and highlight any escalation compared to current membership
Auditable change log: each role change recorded in a visible chronology with who changed it, timestamp, source (console/SSO/CLI), and linked ticket or rationale if provided
Bulk member assignment modal supports CSV upload, SSO attribute suggestions (mapped by email/domain), preflight validation errors, and a dry-run preview before commit
High-risk permission guardrails: for permission sets marked ‘sensitive’ show an explicit two-step confirmation and require at least one approver from the security admin group
Keyboard + screen reader accessibility for all new components and clear focus order for the delegation workflow
Unit tests and visual QA checklist referenced in PR and QA doc; handoff artifacts (Figma + spec) linked in ticket
comments: 2025-11-06 - Priya Raman: Initial UX exploration uploaded. Two patterns: (1) single-page editor with inline scope picker and delegation drawer, (2) split editor/details + timeline. Leaning to single-page to keep context when previewing effective permissions. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/RBAC-v2-Role-Editor
2025-11-07 - Aisha Carter: PM input - require explicit SSO-mapping hints and ability to assign to SAML groups when available. Add a note for mapping attribute precedence (group > email domain).

2025-11-09 - Miguel Alvarez (engineering): Backend can emit structured audit events at /api/v1/audit/events starting next week. For delegation expiry, can surface scheduled revocations; need a field 'delegation_source' to identify automated vs manual. Adding ENG-4120 as dependency.

2025-11-10 - Security review (Leah Chen): Concept approved but request: enforce 2-step approval for role grants that include 'manage_keys' or 'export_data'. Also require storing rationale as part of audit event. Marking security_review_required = true.

2025-11-11 - Design critique: Feedback to reduce cognitive load when a role contains >40 permissions. Proposal: group permissions by capability, show top-line impact (read/write/admin) and provide 'show all' to expand. Follow-up task to prototype grouping heuristics.

2025-11-12 - Aisha Carter: Added acceptance criteria item for bulk CSV dry-run and preflight validation. Linking PRD: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/Security/RBAC+v2+Console+PRD and GH epic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1122
notes:
Design decision: preview computes effective permissions client-side from role definition + member attributes; eng will validate with backend on commit. Trade-off: client preview is fast but must show 'verified on save' badge after server validation.

Follow-ups: 1) small-screen responsive layout for role editor (DES-30347), 2) template library for common scoped roles (DES-30348).
